kypExtensions.summary: The Past–Present–Future grammar of the printed timeline figure: every observational design is anchored at the Present, and the direction of inquiry generates the design and fixes its measure — ONE SLICE of the present (cross-sectional → disease prevalence), a LOOK-BACK from disease (case-control → odds of prior exposure → OR), a FORWARD MARCH from exposure (prospective cohort → disease incidence → RR), and the records variant (retrospective cohort — the same exposure-forward arrow run on previous records, 'Review previous records'); the claim 'the direction fixes the measure' is the KYP synthesis of the printed labels.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the four panels and their labels but never states the generating grammar (stand at the present, choose a direction) nor the direction→measure rule; the synthesis is KYP's.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea MOVE 1 + mechanisms[0] time-axis-map + blocks[3] the steps block + the registry visual's Zone A lanes and rule strip

kypExtensions.summary: The 2×2 'two doors' reading (enter by the DISEASE door → case-control → odds ratio; enter by the EXPOSURE door → cohort → incidence + relative risk; freeze the grid at one moment → cross-sectional → prevalence; no grid at all → case series → description only) plus the unit-of-analysis ladder (individual description → individual comparison → twin pairs → adoptive families → whole populations, with the ecological fallacy as the printed toll of the last step and the genetics pair as the only rung that separates genes from environment).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the seven rows as parallel facts; the two-doors frame, the grid-freeze reading of cross-sectional, and the unit ladder are KYP's organization.
kypExtensions.location: core.why + core.keyIdea MOVES 2–3 + mechanisms[1] comparison-axis-map + blocks[2] the decoder list block

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the printed page — 4 patterns (the case-control COPD odds stem, the cohort smoking-risk stem, the ecological polluted-cities fallacy stem, the twin+adoption schizophrenia heritability stem), 4 traps (case-control vs cohort doors; cross-sectional vs case-control time structure; twin concordance vs adoption; ecological vs individual-level unit), 3 pivots (the measure-router, the two meanings of 'retrospective', the case-series comparison-group tell), and 8 recall cards covering all seven rows plus the figure.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the design definitions only; the attack structure, distractor designs, and question shapes are KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The mnemonic ledger: First Aid's OWN two mnemonics — 'Control the case in the OR.' (Case-control row) and 'Cohort = relative risk.' (Cohort row), both printed in RED inside the MEASURES/EXAMPLE cells (VLM-confirmed) — carried VERBATIM and ATTRIBUTED in the mnemonics array, the memory callout, the verbatim table block, and the visual's cards; plus TWO KYP originals, marked as such: 'FOUR Cs, THEN GENES, THEN POPULATIONS' (the seven-row architecture in printed order) and 'ONE SLICE, TWO DIRECTIONS' (the time-axis grammar).
kypExtensions.rationale: The two in-cell mnemonics are the source's own (attributed, not counted as KYP's); no margin mnemonic prints anywhere on pdf 278 (pdfimages + VLM census, staging-pubh1/vlm-census.txt); the two ALL-CAPS codes are KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The clinical anchor layer: the page's two printed example threads — COPD through three designs (case-control: higher odds of a smoking history; cohort: higher risk of developing COPD; ecological: prevalence higher in more polluted cities) and schizophrenia through the two heritability designs (twin concordance: MZ ≫ DZ; adoption: risk follows the biological parent) — plus the observational-vs-experimental boundary framing (every design on this page only observes; book 257 opens Clinical therapeutic trial, where the investigator intervenes) and the miniCase (the 150+150 COPD records-and-interview vignette routed to case-control/OR against cross-sectional, cohort, and ecological distractors).
kypExtensions.rationale: The examples themselves are printed (FA-own); the thread organization, the boundary framing, the MZ/DZ ~half-genes logic, and the miniCase vignette with its distractors are KYP's design, flagged as such.
